players.product: AvalonMiner bitcoin mining machines (A15 / A16 series; Avalon A1566HA hydro-cooled)

quarterly_data.signal: July 2026 Bitcoin production and mining update (unaudited): Canaan mined 46 BTC, bringing its treasury to 1,917 BTC and 3,952 ETH at month-end. Non-JV installed and operating hashrate were both 10.05 EH/s; at the JV (49% of the Alborz, Bear and Chief Mountain facilities in West Texas, partner WindHQ) operating hashrate rose to 4.20 EH/s and installed hashrate reached 4.85 EH/s as operations stabilized after the Alborz wildfire disruption. North American non-JV fleet efficiency was 17.9 J/TH, all-in power cost US$0.043/kWh, average revenue split 60.6%. Canaan has paused its mining operations in Ethiopia (4.96 EH/s still counted as installed).
quarterly_data.figure: July 2026: 46 BTC mined; 1,917 BTC and 3,952 ETH held; JV 4.20 EH/s operating / 4.85 EH/s installed; Ethiopia paused
